symptoms: BOTH Potassium & Magnesium need to be replaced simultaneously in hypokalaemia (Mg2+ activates the Na+- K+ ATPase pump to promote cellular uptake of K+)

management_steps.details: BOTH Potassium & Magnesium need to be replaced simultaneously in hypokalaemia (Mg2+ activates the Na+- K+ ATPase pump to promote cellular uptake of K+).
40 mmol KCl + 2g MgSO4 in 200 ml 0.9% Normal Saline over 4 hours (via infusion pump / dial-a-flow @ 50 ml/hr).
20 mEq/mmol KCl (10ml) can be administered @ 1ml/min, then re-check potassium level.

warnings: The 20 mEq/mmol KCl (10ml) @ 1ml/min rate applies ONLY to life-threatening hypokalaemia with cardiac arrest or impending arrest; otherwise use the 40 mmol KCl + 2g MgSO4 over 4 hours infusion.
Re-check the potassium level after the life-threatening-hypokalaemia dose.

drugs.item: Potassium chloride (KCl) with magnesium sulphate - standard replacement
drugs.adult_dose: 40 mmol KCl + 2g MgSO4 in 200 ml 0.9% Normal Saline over 4 hours (via infusion pump / dial-a-flow @ 50 ml/hr)
20 mEq/mmol KCl (10ml) @ 1ml/min, then re-check potassium level
drugs.notes: HJH ED 2026, page 95. Cardiac arrest / impending arrest only.
